reason: Compound rule; weighted the review-conduct clauses that carry the operative requirement: whether a report genuinely renders TWO distinct verdicts, whether findings were verified against the codebase and pushed back with technical reasoning, and whether a regression test was narrowed to fit the implementation all require judging the meaning and quality of review content — a two-headings presence check cannot decide any of them.

cost: It is a mapping table — each row points at a gate that is enforced elsewhere; enforcing the map itself would mean re-enforcing every listed gate, i.e. it has no compliance condition of its own.
importance: בינונית — valuable as an index that ties past failures to their catching gates, but the operative force lives entirely in the gates it references.

reason: Compound (screenshot-attached is a presence check) but the operative requirement is correctness of the rendered Hebrew — correct singular/plural on interpolated counts and the correct domain term require evaluating linguistic meaning and quality; even 'no English leak' cannot be decided by a Latin-character pattern without judging loanwords.

cost: A personal resolutions list — each bullet restates a requirement that is (or should be) enforced by its own gate (evidence pasting, 390px screenshots, escalation, flaky-as-bug, diff verification); enforcing the list itself would duplicate those gates.
importance: בינונית — it is a retrospective declaration whose operative content lives in other rules; as its own rule there is no compliance condition.

cost: A historical record of one failure (equipPlan) with its root cause and the gate that now covers it; there is nothing to check — the enforcement belongs to the Waiver Gate it names.
importance: נמוכה — documentation of provenance for another rule, not a requirement.

reason: Deciding whether a plan 'waives, defers, or reinterprets' an approved spec requirement means comparing the meaning of two documents — 'reinterpret' and 'narrowing a DoD line' cannot be decided by presence/absence of any nameable token (a plan can waive without ever writing 'deferred'), so compliance requires judging intent and semantic drift.

Compound: the presence of a quoted spec line in the report is patternable, but the operative requirement is that the quoted line actually justifies this task ('if none → the task should not exist') — deciding whether a spec line genuinely covers the task, and whether a recovered item's relevance verdict is sound, requires evaluating meaning; a verbatim-but-irrelevant quote passes every presence check.

A planning methodology cluster — whether the hardest constraint was truly identified and scheduled first, whether the requirement mapping is genuinely MECE, whether a brief is unambiguous to a newcomer — every clause demands evaluating the quality and meaning of planning content; no artifact pattern decides any of it.

artifact: the brief file handed to a dispatched agent (task-brief template shape, referenced in the Agent dispatch payload)
pattern: brief exists as a file and carries all required fields (a)–(e) non-empty and non-placeholder — exactly what make-brief.mjs/check-brief refuses on; a missing field or a TODO marker = invalid brief
reason: Compound rule — the runs-where allocation table needs judgment, but the operative, enforced demand is the brief/report file contract, which the rule itself already made mechanical ('a missing field = an invalid brief', the generator refuses placeholders).

Whether a value is 'derived/computed', whether the named reader is a real production consumer, and whether that reader actually fires on real data (the L8 clause) all require understanding code semantics and data flow — no textual pattern distinguishes a live reader from a dead one.

pattern: all 12 DoD checklist items present and checked, each with a non-empty pasted-evidence block (command output, exit code, screenshot path), recorded before the ledger entry
reason: Compound container — the adequacy of each item's evidence is judged by the individual sub-rules, but this rule's own operative demand is structural: every box checked with evidence pasted in before done, which is a completeness-of-artifact check.

mechanism_target: git commit introducing a test + implementation pair
observed_prior_facts: the tool-event history: a run of the new test with failing (non-zero) output occurred after the test file was written and before the implementation edits — i.e. RED was actually witnessed, not reconstructed
reason: Compound: 'failing for the intended reason' is a judgment clause, but the operative requirement is the witnessed sequence (test first → observed RED → then implementation), which is a question about prior events observable in the recorded tool history.

mechanism_target: commits implementing an ⚠️R item, checked against its ledger row in docs/ROADMAP-2026-07-30.md §5a
observed_prior_facts: whether the item's ledger row already records an owner-approved joint verdict (בצע / בטל→R-cancelled with reason) BEFORE any implementation work, and that a cancelled row was marked rather than deleted
reason: Compound: the relevance assessment itself is judgment, but the operative requirement is the sequence — verdict recorded with the owner before pickup proceeds — which is a prior-event fact held in the ledger (the state store); a recovered task with no recorded verdict fails mechanically.

Whether a fixture contains 'only what the scenario needs' requires understanding what the scenario needs, and identifying THE negative case requires understanding the guarded behavior — both are judgments about meaning, not detectable by any structural pattern in the fixture.

Deciding whether an assertion targets an 'observable effect that a real consumer reads' versus an unconsumed computed field requires tracing code semantics and consumer paths — no textual pattern in the test separates the two.

artifact: the Agent dispatch payload in the pretooluse:Agent hook
pattern: the dispatch carries an explicit non-empty model (and effort) selection — absence of the field = silent inheritance = violation
reason: Compound: whether the RIGHT model per task type was chosen, and the no-escalation-after-success clause, need judgment/history — but the bolded operative demand is 'chosen explicitly, never silently inherited', which the payload decides by field presence. (The appended L45/L46 material is lessons-log record, not the operative rule.)

The demand is to SKIP ceremony where it adds nothing — deciding whether a case qualifies ('one clear requirement', 'obvious single-cause bug', 'trivial mechanical edit') and whether applied reasoning was cost without evidence requires judging the nature and quality of the work; no artifact pattern marks triviality.

artifact: the gate-prompt payload (the structured question presented to the owner)
pattern: options.length ≤ 4 · header length ≤ 12 characters · multi-select absent on gates · a freeform 'Other' path present
mechanism_target: owner-facing gate prompts (structured question tool payloads)
reason: Every constraint is a countable/structural property of the prompt payload — pure shape rules; no vocabulary entry intercepts the question tool pre-flight, so the check is an observe-and-record on the payload.

cost: It defines what a command's three forms display — reference documentation of behavior; there is no agent obligation whose compliance could be checked (the command either works or is a bug, not a rule violation).
importance: נמוכה — useful usage documentation; any enforcement belongs to tests of the command itself, not to a discipline gate.
